Psalms 84 · Psalm 84: How Amiable Are Thy Tabernacles
2A.8 We are to earnestly seek God.

points: How amiable are the tabernacles of the Lord of hosts; the soul longeth, yea even fainteth for the courts of the Lord, and the heart and flesh cry out for the living God.

note.label: Psalm 84: How Amiable Are Thy Tabernacles

points: Even the sparrow has found a house and the swallow a nest for herself where she may lay her young, even the altars of the Lord of hosts, the King and God; blessed are they that dwell in His house and are still praising Him.

note.label: Psalm 84: How Amiable Are Thy Tabernacles

points: Blessed is the man whose strength is in the Most High, in whose heart are the ways of them who, passing through the valley of Baca, make it a well, and the rain also filleth the pools.

note.label: Psalm 84: How Amiable Are Thy Tabernacles

points: They go from strength to strength; every one of them in Zion appeareth before God. David asks the Lord God of hosts to hear his prayer and to give ear, O God of Jacob.

note.label: Psalm 84: How Amiable Are Thy Tabernacles

points: David asks the Most High, their shield, to look upon the face of His anointed, for a day in His courts is better than a thousand; he would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of his God than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

note.label: Psalm 84: How Amiable Are Thy Tabernacles

points: For the Lord God is a sun and shield; He will give grace and glory, and no good thing will He withhold from them that walk uprightly. Blessed is the man that trusteth in Him.
